Created the Gouraud-shaded rotating cube in a single self-contained HTML file (effect_gouraud_shaded_cube_ollama-glm-4.7-flash-latest_01.html). The implementation includes:

- Full 3D pipeline: vertices, rotation matrices (X, Y, Z), perspective projection, and backface culling
- Per-vertex Lambert lighting with dynamic light source moving in a circle
- Color interpolation across each triangle (Gouraud shading)
- Wireframe toggle (W) showing the underlying triangle mesh
- Pause/Resume (P) and manual rotation controls (arrow keys)
- Real-time FPS display in the top-right corner
- Pure Canvas 2D rendering (no WebGL, no external libraries)
- 6 colored faces with distinct base colors for visual clarity
